blurb: Fieldstone is a private golf club nestled in the rolling hills of Northern Delaware. The Club is anchored by its award winning 18-hole Michael Hurdzan and Dana Fry design golf course. Recognized as one of Golf Inc.'s "Most Admired Private Clubs", Fieldstone boasts a site as astonishing as the challenge.
